cases.name: rule-codec-timed-daily
cases.note: Data shapes: a timed rule, every day, two sorted times.

cases.name: rule-codec-untimed-weekdays
cases.note: Data shapes: an untimed count on chosen ISO weekdays (1 = Monday).

cases.name: rule-codec-timed-every-n-days
cases.note: Data shapes: every N days always stores its anchor and whether it is the default.

cases.name: rule-codec-as-needed
cases.note: Data shapes: as_needed carries no days and no times.

cases.name: rule-codec-unscheduled
cases.note: Data shapes: unscheduled is the member having no Schedule.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-version-other-than-1
cases.note: File 5: the codecs reject any v other than 1.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-unknown-rule-kind
cases.note: File 5: the codecs reject unknown kinds.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-unknown-days-kind
cases.note: File 5: the codecs reject unknown kinds, including the days kind.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-a-time-at-25-00
cases.note: File 5: a time that is not HH:MM in 00:00-23:59 does not decode, in either language.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-a-time-without-a-two-digit-hour
cases.note: File 5: 9:00 is not HH:MM.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-an-impossible-anchor
cases.note: File 5: an every-N anchor must be a real date.

cases.name: rule-codec-rejects-a-fractional-count
cases.note: File 5: a count is an integer.

cases.name: rule-codec-reads-whole-numbers-written-as-floats
cases.note: File 5: JSON cannot tell 2.0 from 2, so both languages read it as the integer.

cases.name: rule-codec-reads-an-anchor-in-year-50-as-written
cases.note: File 5: a four-digit year is taken as written, never as 1950.

cases.name: period-codec-cycle-and-pause
cases.note: Data shapes: a cycle with its anchor, and one inclusive Pause.

cases.name: period-codec-null-is-no-period
cases.note: Data shapes: a null period column means no cycle and no Pause.

cases.name: period-codec-reads-the-empty-object-form
cases.note: Data shapes: writers store null for no cycle and no Pause, but readers accept this form too.

cases.name: period-codec-rejects-version-other-than-1
cases.note: File 5: the codecs reject any v other than 1.

cases.name: period-codec-reads-a-missing-cycle-key-as-null
cases.note: Data shapes: a period without the cycle key reads as no cycle, in both languages.

cases.name: period-codec-rejects-an-impossible-pause-date
cases.note: File 5: Pause dates must be real dates.

cases.name: period-codec-rejects-an-impossible-cycle-anchor
cases.note: File 5: the cycle anchor must be a real date.

cases.name: cuj1-daily-stack-plans-each-member-at-its-time
cases.note: CUJ 1, D4: every member of an ongoing Protocol in effect is planned at its own times.

cases.name: cuj1-nothing-logged-yet-every-row-is-pending
cases.note: CUJ 1, D6: today with logged < planned reads pending; every slot is reported with doseId null.

cases.name: cuj1-log-all-planned-at-0905-picks-the-0900-doses-not-creatine
cases.note: CUJ 1, D6: Log all planned takes today's unfilled timed slots at or before now; creatine's 17:00 is later.

cases.name: cuj1-after-log-all-planned-creatine-stays-pending
cases.note: CUJ 1, D6: the two Doses timed now fill their 09:00 slots and read logged; creatine is still pending.

cases.name: cuj2-trt-logged-at-0840-agemate-still-pending
cases.note: CUJ 2, D6: a Dose before its planned time fills the nearest slot; AgeMate is still due.

cases.name: cuj2-at-0900-only-agemate-is-due
cases.note: CUJ 2, D6: a slot timed exactly now is due; a filled slot and a later slot are not.

cases.name: cuj3-on-period-ends-after-cycle-day-59
cases.note: CUJ 3, D4: 60 on / 30 off anchored 2026-09-01; 2026-10-30 is cycle day 59 (on), 2026-10-31 is day 60 (off).

cases.name: cuj3-cycle-day-65-is-off-cycle
cases.note: CUJ 3, D4: 2026-11-05 is cycle day 65, inside the off-period (days 60-89).

cases.name: cuj3-cycle-day-90-starts-the-next-cycle
cases.note: CUJ 3, D4: 2026-11-29 is day 89 (off); 2026-11-30 is day 90, so (90 mod 90) = 0 is on again.

cases.name: cuj3-off-cycle-day-reads-off-cycle-not-not-logged
cases.note: CUJ 3, D6: with nothing planned and a Protocol reporting off_cycle, the day reads off_cycle.

cases.name: cuj5-pause-reads-paused-for-seven-days
cases.note: CUJ 5, D4: a Pause is inclusive at both ends, so 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-16 are paused.

cases.name: cuj5-pause-does-not-shift-the-cycle
cases.note: CUJ 5, D4: the anchor stays at 2026-09-01 after a Pause, so the off-period still starts on 2026-10-31.

cases.name: cuj5-paused-days-read-paused-and-a-dose-on-one-is-an-extra
cases.note: CUJ 5, D6: paused days read paused; a Dose on a paused day has no slot, so it is an extra and never changes the status.

cases.name: cuj4-day-before-the-start-is-outside
cases.note: CUJ 4, D4 step 1: a date before startLocalDate is outside.

cases.name: cuj4-end-date-is-inclusive
cases.note: CUJ 4, D4: until is inclusive, so 2026-11-14 is planned and 2026-11-15 is outside.

cases.name: cuj4-after-the-end-date-reads-not-planned-outside
cases.note: CUJ 4, D6: the last day of the course is logged; the day after reads not_planned with reason outside.

cases.name: cuj6-edit-to-mon-wed-fri-applies-from-its-date
cases.note: CUJ 6, D1: dates before 2026-10-19 use the daily 09:00 version; from Monday 2026-10-19 the weekdays [1,3,5] 07:00 version applies, so Tuesday is not_scheduled_today.

cases.name: cuj6-past-days-keep-their-own-plan
cases.note: CUJ 6, D1, D6: each day is compared against its own version; a Dose on Tuesday is an extra on a not-planned day.

cases.name: cuj7-dose-logged-after-midnight-for-last-night-fills-yesterday
cases.note: CUJ 7, D6: the Dose carries the true local date and time (2026-10-25 21:05), so it fills yesterday's 21:00 slot; today stays pending.

cases.name: match-2050-dose-fills-the-2100-slot-not-the-0900-one
cases.note: D6 step 3: a Dose fills the unfilled timed slot nearest its time (20:50 is 10 min from 21:00, 710 from 09:00); the past day reads partly_logged.

cases.name: after-a-2050-dose-only-the-0900-slot-is-due
cases.note: D6: the 21:00 slot already holds the 20:50 Dose, so at 21:30 only the unfilled 09:00 slot is due.

cases.name: match-an-early-and-a-late-dose-each-fill-their-nearest-slot
cases.note: D6 step 3: 07:30 is 90 min early for 09:00 and 23:15 is 135 min late for 21:00; each fills its nearest slot.

cases.name: match-two-morning-doses-the-first-in-order-takes-0900
cases.note: D6 steps 2-3: Doses are taken in local-time order; 08:00 takes 09:00 first, so 08:55 takes the only unfilled timed slot, 21:00.

cases.name: match-equidistant-dose-fills-the-earlier-slot
cases.note: D6 step 3: 10:00 is 60 min from both 09:00 and 11:00; on a tie the earlier slot wins.

cases.name: match-mixed-timed-and-untimed-slots
cases.note: D6 steps 1 and 3: slots order by time with untimed last, then Protocol id, so protocol-b's 08:00 is slot 0; once no timed slot is unfilled a Dose fills the first unfilled untimed slot.

cases.name: match-a-dose-beyond-the-planned-count-is-an-extra
cases.note: D6 step 3: with nothing unfilled the second Dose is an extra; extras are counted and never change the status.

cases.name: status-today-partly-logged-reads-pending
cases.note: D6: today with 0 < logged < planned reads pending, never partly_logged.

cases.name: every-n-days-anchor-before-the-range
cases.note: D4: every 3 days from the default anchor 2026-09-01; 2026-10-01 is day 30 and 2026-10-04 day 33 (planned), the days between are not_scheduled_today.

cases.name: every-n-days-user-anchor-before-the-start
cases.note: D4: a user-set anchor (2026-08-30) is counted from, not the start; 2026-10-01 is day 32, 2026-10-02 day 33 (planned), 2026-10-03 day 34.

cases.name: cycle-anchor-before-the-start-counts-from-the-anchor
cases.note: D4: 21 on / 7 off anchored 2026-09-20, before the 2026-10-01 start; 2026-10-10 is cycle day 20 (on), 2026-10-11 is day 21 (off). Counting from the start would put both on.

cases.name: backdated-protocol-start-plans-its-past-days
cases.note: D1: a Protocol created on 2026-10-26 with start 2026-10-20 gives its members a first version dated from the start, so those past days are planned.

cases.name: backdated-protocol-past-days-read-not-logged
cases.note: D1, D6: the backdated days are past and have nothing logged, so they read not_logged; the day before the start reads not_planned, outside.

cases.name: start-moved-later-past-an-edit
cases.note: D1: the start moved from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-12, past the 2026-09-10 edit; ver-x-3 copies the version in effect on 2026-09-12 (ver-x-2). Dates before the new start are outside although versions cover them.

cases.name: start-moved-earlier-copies-the-earliest-version
cases.note: D1: the start moved from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-05; ver-x-3 copies the earliest version dated from the new start, so the new days are planned, not removed.

cases.name: start-moved-earlier-keeps-the-later-edit
cases.note: D1: the applying version is the latest effectiveFrom on or before the date; ver-x-3 has the largest id but the earliest date, so 2026-10-15 still uses ver-x-2.

cases.name: default-anchors-moved-with-the-start
cases.note: D1, D4: the start moved from 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-05, and both default anchors moved with it. Cycle 3 on / 2 off and every 2 days now count from 2026-09-05. Counted from the old anchor 2026-09-01, 2026-09-05 would have been cycle day 4, an off day.

cases.name: overlapping-protocols-for-one-compound
cases.note: D4: one Compound in two Protocols gets one PlanDay per Protocol; protocol-bulk ends 2026-10-31.

cases.name: overlapping-protocols-sum-their-planned-doses
cases.note: D6: planned doses sum across Protocols; same-time slots order by Protocol id, and an equidistant Dose fills the earlier slot. Once one Protocol plans a dose, another's outside state is ignored.

cases.name: two-versions-on-the-same-date-larger-id-wins
cases.note: D1: ver-trt-2 and ver-trt-3 share effectiveFrom 2026-10-19; the larger id wins, whatever the array order.

cases.name: compound-added-mid-course-reads-removed-before-its-first-version
cases.note: D1, D4 step 4: creatine was added to the started Protocol on 2026-10-15; its member row covers dates from its first version, so 2026-10-14 is removed (not yet added).

cases.name: compound-added-mid-course-earlier-days-read-not-planned-removed
cases.note: D1, D6: adding a Compound mid-course does not turn its earlier days into not_logged.

cases.name: removed-and-re-added-member-reads-removed-in-the-gap
cases.note: D1: member-x-1 is archived on 2026-10-05 (still planned that day) and member-x-2 re-adds the Compound from 2026-10-08; the days between are removed.

cases.name: member-removed-and-re-added-the-same-day-larger-member-id-wins
cases.note: D1: both member rows cover 2026-10-10 (archive day of member-x-1, first version of member-x-2); the larger memberId wins.

cases.name: member-removed-today-is-still-planned-today
cases.note: D1: the archive day itself is still planned; from the next day the member is removed.

cases.name: member-removed-today-reads-pending-and-later-dates-are-not-returned
cases.note: D1, Shared core API: today is still pending; dates after today are not returned.

cases.name: member-without-versions-and-unscheduled-version-plan-nothing
cases.note: D1, D4 step 5: a member with no versions, or whose applying version is unscheduled (a cleared Schedule), is no_schedule.

cases.name: as-needed-version-plans-nothing
cases.note: D4 step 5: an as_needed rule plans nothing and reports as_needed.

cases.name: archived-protocol-counts-through-its-archive-date
cases.note: D1, D4 step 4: an archived Protocol still plans up to and including its archivedOn; after it, removed.

cases.name: archived-protocol-past-days-still-count
cases.note: D1, D6: past days of an archived Protocol, including the archive date, keep their statuses.

cases.name: status-each-not-planned-reason
cases.note: D6: with nothing planned and no paused or off_cycle Protocol, the day is not_planned with the reason its Protocol reports.

cases.name: status-precedence-across-protocols
cases.note: D6: planned beats paused beats off_cycle beats not_planned, whose reason is taken in the order not_scheduled_today, as_needed, no_schedule, removed, outside.

cases.name: due-unfilled-excludes-later-timed-and-past-dates-includes-untimed
cases.note: D6: only today's unfilled slots count; a slot timed after now and a filled slot are excluded, an untimed slot and a slot timed exactly now are included.

cases.name: effect-bounds-offset-minus-180
cases.note: D2: local midnight minus the offset; UTC-3 midnight is 03:00Z, and the inclusive end becomes the next day's midnight.

cases.name: effect-bounds-offset-zero
cases.note: D2: with offset 0 the bounds are UTC midnights.

cases.name: effect-bounds-offset-plus-540
cases.note: D2: midnight on 2026-09-01 in UTC+9 is 15:00Z on 2026-08-31.

cases.name: effect-bounds-open-end
cases.note: D2: an ongoing Protocol has no end; endDate is null and Effect uses now.

cases.name: effect-bounds-one-day-course-across-the-year-end
cases.note: D2: an end equal to the start is one whole local day; the day after 2026-12-31 is 2027-01-01.

cases.name: effect-bounds-offset-plus-330
cases.note: D2: a non-whole-hour offset; UTC+5:30 midnight on 2026-03-01 is 18:30Z on 2026-02-28.
